filter_counterexample.interpretation: An unconstrained changing recording transfer can exactly mimic different mechanisms. Fixed or independently calibrated readout is necessary for this inference; a restricted filter family could behave differently.

answers.refuted: Pure coupling inference can ignore conductance shunting without testing bias; unrestricted recording drift permits unique mechanism recovery.
answers.survives: Conditional scalar-mechanism inference with explicitly modeled nuisance and independent calibration; no anatomical topology recovered.
answers.next_allowed: Quantify real calibration/input availability; do not replace missing biological measurements with oracle values or synthetic power.
